mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_notification_outbox (event_id, event_type, payload, status, attempts, max_attempts, next_retry_time, last_error, message_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{attempts}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{lastError}, #{messageId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, event_type, payload, status, attempts, max_attempts, next_retry_time, last_error, message_id, create_time, update_time FROM biz_notification_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND (next_retry_time IS NULL OR next_retry_time <= #{now}) ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{batchSize} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_notification_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', attempts = #{attempts}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE biz_notification_outbox SET status = 'DEAD', attempts = #{attempts}, next_retry_time = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = #{now} WHERE id = #{id}
